name: São Sebastião do Paraíso (Brazil)
description: Light blue field divided into quarters by a red cross, charged at the centre with a white lozenge bearing the municipal arms.
history: São Sebastião do Paraíso is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. According to Flags of the World the arms symbolise the municipal government, the lozenge the town itself and the stripes issuing from it the radiation of municipal power over the territory.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown
